text.content:
A corpo-and-crim cocktail bar in a church basement since 2045.

Region: Downtown, City Center (#26)
Controlled by: Its bartender, Moira Kavanagh, keeps the booths
The feel of it: Corpos and crims meeting in the same booths
Danger: SC 7

Moira has kept the same secrets since 2045. Lyle Thompson has a receipt from a dinner here in March 2070 between Michiko Arasaka and Lucius Rhyne.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.03, 05, 07
